title: $\mathcal{Z}$-stable and selfless inclusions for the infinite braid group
summary: Let $B_\infty$ and $P_\infty$ be the braid group and the pure braid group on infinitely many strands. We show that the inclusion $C^*_r(P_\infty)\subseteq C^*_r(B_\infty)$ is $\mathcal{Z}$-stable and selfless. Hence every intermediate inclusion and every intermediate $C^*$-algebra is $\mathcal{Z}$-stable and selfless. The intermediate $C^*$-algebras are natural examples of simple nonnuclear $\mathcal{Z}$-stable $C^*$-algebras, and they are singly generated.
